data.name: Nina
data.gender_notes: Nina is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nina is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ninam', meaning 'graceful, pleasing, and dainty'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Parvati is often referred to as 'Nina', symbolizing the embodiment of feminine grace and beauty. The name Nina carries the meaning “Dainty, Graceful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nina usually hope their child will grow to embody dainty, graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of feminine grace and beauty.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
